finePrint.summary: Lifetime deals are completely non-refundable, which means a lifetime-deal buyer cannot get money back.

quote.text: All payments are non-refundable unless otherwise stated in our refund policy. Discounted products and lifetime deals (LTD) are non-refundable under any circumstances.

finePrint.summary: Buyers must request a refund within 10 days of payment or lose eligibility.

quote.text: Refund requests must be made within 10 days of the payment date.

finePrint.summary: The pricing page advertises a 10-day money-back guarantee for plan purchases.

quote.text: Plans & Pricing Choose the plan that’s right for you or your company. 10 days money-back guarantee. Start for free today, upgrade later.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change the Terms at any time, with notice by email or website posting.

quote.text: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by email or by posting a notice on our website.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can suspend or terminate access at its discretion without notice for violations or harmful conduct.

quote.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the Services at our discretion, without notice, if you violate these Terms or engage in any conduct that we deem harmful to the Services or other users.

trials.claim: Tier 1 includes all future Basic, Premium or Business plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1), Premium (Tier 2) or Business (Tiers 3+) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A Tier 1 buyer reports their account reverted to a trial expiring on 6th Feb 2026, which directly conflicts with lasting lifetime access and future updates.

exhibits.quote: I bought 1st Tier of Sheetany on Appsumo on 23rd January 2026. I found lately it says my account is on trial . expires on 6th Feb 2026.
exhibits.argument: Tier 1 buyer reports account reverted to expiring trial and cannot edit or launch, undermining lifetime future updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the Services at our discretion, without notice, if you violate these Terms or engage in any conduct that we deem harmful to the Services or other users.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves discretionary termination power which allows taking back access to future updates.

trials.claim: Tier 2 includes all future Basic, Premium or Business plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1), Premium (Tier 2) or Business (Tiers 3+) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit is a standard termination clause for violating the terms, which does not show compliant Tier 2 buyers will lose future plan updates, and no exhibit confirms they will receive them.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the Services at our discretion, without notice, if you violate these Terms or engage in any conduct that we deem harmful to the Services or other users.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves discretionary termination power which allows taking back access to future updates.

trials.claim: Tier 1 allows upgrading or downgrading between 3 license tiers
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade or downgrade between 3 license tiers
trials.reasoning: A buyer states they purchased Tier 1 and then upgraded to Tier 2, directly showing tier movement; the non-refundable term does not show tier switching is blocked.

exhibits.quote: Discounted products and lifetime deals (LTD) are non-refundable under any circumstances.
exhibits.argument: Non-refundable lifetime deals undermine practical ability to downgrade between tiers where a price difference would apply.

exhibits.quote: Initially, I purchased Tier 1. Then, after using it, I decided to upgrade my plan to Tier 2.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms a Tier 1 purchase could be upgraded to Tier 2.

trials.claim: Tier 2 allows upgrading or downgrading between 3 license tiers
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade or downgrade between 3 license tiers
trials.reasoning: The review only says the buyer may upgrade in the future, not that they actually could or did upgrade or downgrade from Tier 2.

exhibits.quote: Discounted products and lifetime deals (LTD) are non-refundable under any circumstances.
exhibits.argument: Non-refundable lifetime deals undermine practical ability to downgrade between tiers where a price difference would apply.

exhibits.quote: For what it promises and what it costs, this LTD overdelivers with its ease of use. I may even upgrade my tier.
exhibits.argument: A Tier 2 buyer states they can upgrade their tier, confirming upgrade ability from Tier 2.

trials.claim: Tier 3 allows upgrading or downgrading between 3 license tiers

trials.reasoning: No exhibit shows a Tier 3 buyer upgrading or downgrading, and the non-refundable term alone does not prove tier switching is unavailable.
